_comment_toolToggles: Optional per-tool enable/disable. When 'enabledTools' is a non-empty array, ONLY those tools are exposed (allowlist). Otherwise, any tool listed in 'disabledTools' is hidden (denylist). enabledTools takes precedence. Env overrides: COLLIBRA_ENABLED_TOOLS / COLLIBRA_DISABLED_TOOLS (comma-separated).
_comment_skillsDir: Optional: external skills directory merged over the embedded catalog. Layout: <dir>/<namespace>/<name>/SKILL.md. Env override: COLLIBRA_MCP_SKILLS_DIR.
_comment_http: Optional: serve MCP over streamable HTTP on localhost instead of stdio. Also enabled by --http[=port] or COLLIBRA_MCP_HTTP_PORT.
_comment_validateOutput: Optional: when true, tool outputs are checked against their outputSchema and mismatches are logged (warn-only).
